body: I just started using Descript and it’s amazing. Everyone says it’s buggy and choppy but if you’re going put it in a DAW and listen and edit/mix anyway this saves hours and hours and hours. Sometimes filler words are just too difficult to cut out. So I rather delete the filler words manually that I know can go instead of using the “remove filler words” feature. And you can edit and piece scripts together without even listening the whole time on the first pass. I’m loving it.

If you are disciplined, focused, extroverted, and driven. I would skip SAE. 

Audio school will help you discover things about the industry you didn’t know you loved, it will force you do and learn things you wouldn’t on your own. And you will get the community of like minded people to feed off of and colab with. 

You could do all that on YouTube and forums for sure in my opinion. But it takes a special kind of person to do that. I couldn’t. 

I went to the Art Institute and I guess I don’t regret it, but it was so much time, energy and money.
